content: Unconditional doc_attribution adds related amendments/integrated versions to an exact self_code/original-standard request; real reads return3 documents where only original matches.
AND between distinct version targets makes the file predicate impossible; amendment-set predicate excludes all3 desired documents. Both real CLI outputs are empty complete sets.
Unfiltered clause extraction counts chapter headings as answer items; range parser selects first target/PM2.5 and does not propagate unconfirmed/error/partial to the result.
Rowspan and average-time subrows repeat legitimate project numbers; comparing every row to1..N creates false missing-row degradation on complete real tables.
First regex-matching block can be table of contents; current syn002 and both syn004 typed references target TOC instead of substantive body. Full table expected sets still missing.
Evidence key loses workspace and eligibility never checks frozen source/catalog or stale result status; isolated production benchmark paths incorrectly score1.0.
OOV concept is removed in core_AND and an early hit prevents trying its known synonym; appended code adjacency probes are independently skipped by cases[:20].
